item.title: ‘See Her Win’ Girls Sports Festival to Be Held at Penn State
item.description: A new girls-only, multi-sport festival is coming to Centre County this spring. The HVSEA is hosting the event with Teammates for Life, the women's sports initiative founded by longtime Penn State field hockey coach Char Morett-Curtiss. item.title: Guy Gadowsky Says Gavin McKenna Will Play in Penn State’s Upcoming Series Against No. 2 Michigan
item.description: For the first time since the aftermath of the Beaver Stadium game, Penn State head coach Guy Gadowsky met with the media on Wednesday, with one glaring topic on everyone’s minds. Gadowsky confirmed that Gavin McKenna will play in the No. 6 Nittany Lions' series at No. 2 Michigan this weekend after he was charged with misdemeanor simple assault and summary offenses of harassment and disorderly conduct on Feb. 4. item.title: State College Borough Government Hit by Cyberattack
item.description: State College government was the victim of a cybersecurity attack on Wednesday. The borough's information security division "acted quickly to stop the attack," borough officials said in a statement. "While the attack has been stopped, it will take several days to review and recover," according to the statement. item.title: ‘We Love Big Matches.’ Penn State Wrestling Ready for Showdown With Ohio State
item.description: How long will Cael Sanderson and the Nittany Lions dynasty last? Are they truly unbeatable? But on Friday night, wrestling fans may get closer to an answer. item.title: Centre Safe, Fellow Rape Crisis Centers Urge Pa. Lawmakers to Boost Support After Shapiro Proposes Flat Funding
item.description: State College-based Centre Safe has joined peer organizations statewide in voicing frustration with Gov. Josh Shapiro's proposal of flat funding for rape crisis centers in Pennsylvania's 2026-27 budget, and urging lawmakers to bolster support. Shapiro's proposed budget, unveiled on Feb. 3, includes a $12.1 million line item for the state's 47 rape crisis centers, the same amount allocated in 2025.
